model.name: DistributedRamanFiber
model.propagator: in-house symmetric NumPy SSFM (never PyNLO path)
model.signal_effects: loss + CD + Kerr retained; channel ISRS not modelled
model.ase: not included in this reference dataset (dra_ase_model='none')

nli_method: Per channel, fit one complex scalar a to NL ≈ a*LIN in the channel band, then take the band power of the residual NL-a*LIN as NLI. This removes the common phase/gain that a coherent receiver would equalize. nli_power_raw_w (no fit) is also recorded. out_linear uses the same pumps/loss/CD but n2=0.
notes: DRA ASE is optional in the model but disabled for this dataset; SNR values are NLI-limited.
Pumps are undepleted and uncoupled; Gaussian Raman spectrum with 13.2 THz peak, 2.12 THz sigma.
Channel-to-channel ISRS is not modelled (raman_r3=None) in this dataset.

3ch.nli_definition: In-band additive NLI after one complex common-gain projection NL-a*LIN; 50 GHz ideal rectangular analysis band; SNR_NLI=signal/NLI; no ASE.

5ch.nli_definition: In-band additive NLI after one complex common-gain projection NL-a*LIN; 50 GHz ideal rectangular analysis band; SNR_NLI=signal/NLI; no ASE.

7ch.nli_definition: In-band additive NLI after one complex common-gain projection NL-a*LIN; 50 GHz ideal rectangular analysis band; SNR_NLI=signal/NLI; no ASE.
